rounds.text: Baid Finserv is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a DCF-derived margin of safety of 69.5% [E38, E60]. This undervaluation is underscored by a price-to-book ratio of 0.63x [E2, E51] and an EV/EBITDA of 8.12x, both of which sit well below their respective sector benchmarks [E7, E11]. The most compelling signal of internal confidence is the aggressive accumulation by promoters, who have increased their stake by 14.92 percentage points since December 2023 [E34]. Furthermore, the company is demonstrating operational efficiency by outperforming sector benchmarks in ROA, ROE, and ROCE [E8, E9, E10]. While recent results show a turnaround with 14% YoY net profit growth and accelerating earnings [E57, E59, E63], the market has yet to reflect this improvement in the share price [E63]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with negative operating cash flow [E30, E31], a low 3-year ROE [E54], and the stock currently trading below its 200-day moving average [E42, E62].
